messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "eradicate Helicobacter pylori"
set: ["eradicate Helicobacter pylori", "Helicobacter pylori", "Helicobacter pylori infection", "reduces stomach acid production", "decreasing the amount of acid the stomach produces", "neutralize existing stomach acid", "include stomach acid reducer such as omeprazole, Nexium, or Prilosec", "stomach acid reducer", "proton pump inhibitor (PPI)", "use all medications as directed when taking with clarithromycin and/or lansoprazole to treat stomach ulcer", "lowering inflammation and immune activity", "Proton pump inhibitors", "slowing gastric emptying", "fights bacteria", "use slow-release tablets to reduce gastric side effects", "stomach acid medicine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
